zh: 会议几点开始？
en: What time does the meeting start?
alt: When's the meeting?
point: 一般疑问要加 does，不说 What time the meeting start

zh: 你今天不是休假吗？
en: Aren't you off today?
alt: Weren't you supposed to be on leave today?
point: “你不是…吗”用否定疑问 Aren't you…?；休假说 off

zh: 你清过缓存没有？
en: Have you cleared your cache?
alt: Did you clear the cache?
point: “…过没有”用 Have you done…?；清缓存是 clear the cache

zh: 这个密码是谁改的？
en: Who changed this password?
alt: Who's changed the password?
point: 问主语用 Who + 动词，不要加 did

zh: 你们几点关门？
en: What time do you close?
alt: When do you close?
point: 问店家用 do you，不说 What time you close

zh: 这个辣不辣？
en: Is this one spicy?
alt: Is it hot?
point: “辣不辣”是一般疑问 Is it…?，不说 spicy or not spicy

zh: 昨天谁赢了？
en: Who won yesterday?
alt: Who won the game yesterday?
point: 问主语直接 Who won，不说 Who did win

zh: 你多久去一次健身房？
en: How often do you go to the gym?
alt: How many times a week do you go to the gym?
point: “多久一次”是 How often，不是 How long

zh: 这双鞋多少钱？
en: How much are these shoes?
alt: How much do these shoes cost?
point: 鞋是复数，用 How much are these…

zh: 请问试衣间在哪儿？
en: Where are the changing rooms?
alt: Excuse me, where can I try this on?
point: 试衣间英式说 changing rooms，复数用 are

zh: 去机场要多久？
en: How long does it take to get to the airport?
alt: How long's it take to the airport?
point: “要多久”用 How long does it take，别漏 it

zh: 这趟车到不到Britomart？
en: Does this bus go to Britomart?
alt: Is this the bus for Britomart?
point: “到不到”用 Does this bus go to…?，不说 arrive or not

zh: 你怎么了？哪里不舒服？
en: What's wrong? Are you not feeling well?
alt: What's the matter? Are you feeling unwell?
point: “怎么了”说 What's wrong，不说 How are you

zh: 你吃药了吗？
en: Have you taken your medicine?
alt: Did you take your pills?
point: 吃药用 take，不是 eat

zh: 钥匙你放哪儿了？
en: Where did you put the keys?
alt: Where have you put the keys?
point: “放哪儿了”用 Where did you put…，put 过去式不变

zh: 你还没睡啊？
en: Are you still up?
alt: Haven't you gone to bed yet?
point: “还没睡”说 still up，不说 still not sleep

zh: 你是哪里人？
en: Where are you from?
alt: Where are you originally from?
point: “哪里人”说 Where are you from，介词 from 放句末

zh: 今天天气真好，是吧？
en: Lovely day, isn't it?
alt: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
point: “是吧”用反义疑问 isn't it?，不说 yes?

zh: 这个月房租你交了吗？
en: Have you paid this month's rent?
alt: Did you pay the rent this month?
point: “交了吗”用现在完成 Have you paid…?

zh: 我欠你多少钱？
en: How much do I owe you?
alt: What do I owe you?
point: “欠你多少”说 How much do I owe you，别漏 do

zh: 你知道Sarah今天在不在办公室吗？
en: Do you know if Sarah's in the office today?
alt: Do you know whether Sarah's in today?
point: 间接疑问用 if + 陈述语序，不说 if is Sarah

zh: 这个报告周五之前能做完吗？客户在催了。
en: Will the report be done by Friday? The client's chasing us.
alt: Can we get the report finished by Friday? The client keeps asking.
point: “做完”说 be done by；“催”说 chase

zh: 你知道这个报错是什么意思吗？我搜了半天也没搞懂。
en: Do you know what this error means? I've been googling it for ages.
alt: Any idea what this error means? I've searched everywhere and still can't work it out.
point: 间接疑问 what this error means，不说 what does it mean

zh: 你没把改动推上去吗？我这边还是看不到。
en: Didn't you push your changes? I still can't see them on my end.
alt: Haven't you pushed the changes yet? They're not showing up for me.
point: “你没…吗”用否定疑问 Didn't you…?

zh: 这道菜要等多久？我们一个小时后还有事。
en: How long will this dish take? We've got to be somewhere in an hour.
alt: How long's the wait for this? We need to leave in an hour.
point: 等多久说 How long will it take；“有事”说 be somewhere

zh: 你们是一起付还是分开付？分开的话我可以帮你们拆单。
en: Are you paying together or separately? I can split the bill if you like.
alt: Is this all on one bill, or are you splitting it?
point: 选择疑问 A or B?；分开付说 split the bill

zh: 你觉得这个赛季哪个队最有可能夺冠？
en: Which team do you reckon is most likely to win this season?
alt: Who do you think will win the title this season?
point: 插入 do you reckon 后用陈述语序；reckon 是 Kiwi 常用的 think

zh: 你不是说膝盖受伤了吗？怎么还去踢球？
en: Didn't you say you'd hurt your knee? Why are you still playing football?
alt: I thought you'd injured your knee. How come you're still playing?
point: “你不是说…吗”用 Didn't you say…?；“怎么还”用 Why / How come

zh: 请问洗手液在哪个货架？我找了一圈没找到。
en: Excuse me, which aisle is the hand soap in? I've looked everywhere.
alt: Sorry, where can I find the hand soap? I can't seem to find it.
point: 超市货架说 aisle；介词 in 放句末

zh: 这个能退吗？我昨天买的，还没拆。
en: Can I return this? I bought it yesterday and haven't opened it.
alt: Is it possible to get a refund? I only bought it yesterday and it's still unopened.
point: “能退吗”说 Can I return this，不说 Can this return

zh: 你知道最后一班渡轮几点开吗？
en: Do you know what time the last ferry leaves?
alt: Any idea when the last ferry goes?
point: 间接疑问 what time the last ferry leaves，不加 does

zh: 我们到底什么时候能登机？已经延误两个小时了。
en: When are we actually going to board? It's already been delayed two hours.
alt: When do we get to board? We've been delayed two hours already.
point: “到底”用 actually；延误了多久用完成时

zh: 你最近睡得怎么样？是不是压力太大了？
en: How have you been sleeping lately? Are you under a lot of stress?
alt: How's your sleep been? Is work stressing you out?
point: “最近…怎么样”用 How have you been + -ing

zh: 医生下一次什么时候有空？我需要复查一下。
en: When's the doctor next available? I need a follow-up appointment.
alt: When can I next see the doctor? I need to come back for a check-up.
point: “什么时候有空”说 When's … available；复查是 follow-up

zh: 谁又把脏碗留在水槽里了？说好了要轮流洗的。
en: Who left the dirty dishes in the sink again? We agreed to take turns.
alt: Who's left their dishes in the sink again? I thought we were taking turns.
point: 问主语 Who left…，不加 did；轮流说 take turns

zh: 暖气是不是坏了？屋里怎么这么冷。
en: Is the heater broken? Why is it so cold in here?
alt: Has the heat pump stopped working? It's freezing in here.
point: “怎么这么冷”用 Why is it so cold，主语用 it

zh: 你还记得我们上次是在哪儿见的吗？我一下子想不起来了。
en: Do you remember where we met last time? It's completely slipped my mind.
alt: Can you remember where we last caught up? I can't think of it.
point: 间接疑问 where we met，不说 where did we meet

zh: 你周末过得怎么样？有没有去哪儿玩？
en: How was your weekend? Did you get up to anything fun?
alt: Did you have a good weekend? Go anywhere nice?
point: “去哪儿玩”口语说 get up to anything，不说 go where play

zh: 你知道现在房贷利率大概是多少吗？我想重新固定一下。
en: Do you know what mortgage rates are at the moment? I'm looking to refix.
alt: Any idea what interest rates are like right now? My mortgage is coming up for refixing.
point: 间接疑问 what rates are，不说 what are rates

zh: 你上个月是不是多扣了我一次钱？账单上有两笔一样的。
en: Did you charge me twice last month? There are two identical payments on my statement.
alt: Have I been charged twice? My statement shows the same amount two times.
point: “多扣一次钱”说 charge me twice；账单是 statement

zh: 我想问一下，下周的培训是我们组都要参加，还是只需要新人去？
en: I was wondering if the whole team needs to go to next week's training, or just the new starters?
alt: Could you let me know whether everyone on the team has to attend the training next week, or only the new people?
point: 委婉提问用 I was wondering if + 陈述语序

zh: 我们不是上周就定好用这个方案了吗？为什么现在又要改？
en: Didn't we agree on this approach last week? Why are we changing it now?
alt: I thought we'd signed off on this plan last week. How come we're changing it again?
point: 否定疑问 Didn't we…? 表示惊讶；“定好”说 agree on / sign off

zh: 你能查一下为什么部署老是失败吗？我看了日志也没看出什么问题。
en: Could you look into why the deployment keeps failing? I've been through the logs and can't see anything wrong.
alt: Can you check why the deploy keeps falling over? The logs don't show anything obvious.
point: 间接疑问 why … keeps failing 不倒装；“老是”用 keep + -ing

zh: 这个bug只在生产环境出现，还是测试环境也能复现？
en: Does this bug only show up in production, or can you reproduce it in the test environment as well?
alt: Is this a prod-only bug, or can it be reproduced in test too?
point: 选择疑问两半都用疑问语序；复现是 reproduce

zh: 不好意思，我们点的菜是不是被忘了？已经等了快四十分钟了。
en: Sorry, has our order been forgotten? We've been waiting for nearly forty minutes for our mains.
alt: Excuse me, do you know what's happening with our mains? It's been almost forty minutes.
point: 被动疑问 Has … been forgotten?；等了多久用完成进行时

zh: 你知道这家店要不要提前订位吗？周五晚上一般人很多。
en: Do you know if we need to book this place in advance? It's usually packed on Friday nights.
alt: Do you know whether we have to make a reservation? It's normally really busy on a Friday night.
point: 间接疑问 if we need to…；订位说 book

zh: 你看昨晚的比赛了吗？最后那个达阵简直不可思议，对吧？
en: Did you watch the game last night? That last try was unbelievable, wasn't it?
alt: Did you catch the match last night? The try at the end was incredible, eh?
point: 反义疑问 was…, wasn't it?；达阵是 try，Kiwi 也说 eh

zh: 你知道下赛季报名什么时候截止吗？我可不想再错过了。
en: Do you know when the registration deadline is for next season? I don't want to miss it again.
alt: When do sign-ups close for next season, do you know? I don't want to miss out again.
point: 间接疑问里 is 放后面：when the deadline is

zh: 这台吸尘器和那台有什么区别？价格差了快两百块。
en: What's the difference between this vacuum and that one? There's almost two hundred dollars between them.
alt: How's this vacuum different from that one? One's nearly $200 more.
point: “有什么区别”说 What's the difference between A and B

zh: 你们不是有价格匹配吗？同一款在Noel Leeming便宜五十块。
en: Don't you guys do price matching? The exact same model is fifty dollars cheaper at Noel Leeming.
alt: I thought you offered price matching? Noel Leeming has the same one for $50 less.
point: 否定疑问 Don't you…? 表示“不是…吗”

zh: 你能告诉我从这儿怎么去Hobbiton吗？我们没租车。
en: Could you tell me how we can get to Hobbiton from here? We haven't hired a car.
alt: What's the best way to get to Hobbiton from here without a car?
point: Could you tell me how we can… 用陈述语序；租车说 hire a car

zh: 我们的行李是直接转到奥克兰，还是要在悉尼取了再重新托运？
en: Will our bags go straight through to Auckland, or do we have to collect them in Sydney and check them in again?
alt: Are our bags checked through to Auckland, or do we need to pick them up in Sydney and recheck them?
point: 选择疑问两半都用疑问语序；托运是 check in

zh: 你不觉得你最近加班太多了吗？身体要紧，别硬撑。
en: Don't you think you've been doing too much overtime lately? Your health comes first, so don't push yourself too hard.
alt: Aren't you working way too much overtime these days? Look after yourself and don't overdo it.
point: “你不觉得…吗”用 Don't you think…?

zh: 我想知道这个检查需不需要空腹，还有大概多久能出结果。
en: I'd like to know whether I need to fast before the test, and roughly how long the results will take.
alt: Can you tell me if I have to fast beforehand, and when I'll get the results?
point: 间接疑问 whether I need to… / how long … will take，不倒装

zh: 你能问问房东，热水到底什么时候来修吗？都坏了一个星期了。
en: Could you ask the landlord when exactly they're coming to fix the hot water? It's been broken for a week.
alt: Can you check with the landlord when someone's going to sort out the hot water? It's been out for a week now.
point: 间接疑问 when they're coming，不说 when are they coming

zh: 家里的网是不是又出问题了，还是只有我这样？我刚才开视频会议断了好几次。
en: Is the Wi-Fi playing up again, or is it just me? My video call kept dropping out just now.
alt: Is the internet slow again or is it only me? My video call cut out a few times.
point: …, or is it just me? 很常用；网络出毛病 Kiwi 说 playing up

zh: 你应该认识Tom吧？他以前好像跟你在同一家公司。
en: You know Tom, don't you? I think he used to work at the same company as you.
alt: You've met Tom, haven't you? I'm pretty sure he used to work with you.
point: “…吧？”用反义疑问 You know…, don't you?

zh: 你这周六有安排吗？我们几个想去Piha走走，你要不要一起？
en: Have you got anything on this Saturday? A few of us are heading out to Piha for a walk if you're keen.
alt: Are you busy on Saturday? A few of us are going out to Piha for a walk, do you want to come?
point: “有安排吗”说 Have you got anything on?，不说 have arrangement

zh: 你知道我们能不能用KiwiSaver的钱付首付吗？我们打算明年买房。
en: Do you know if we can use our KiwiSaver for a house deposit? We're planning to buy next year.
alt: Is it possible to take money out of KiwiSaver for the deposit? We're hoping to buy a house next year.
point: 间接疑问 if we can… 用陈述语序；首付是 deposit

zh: 这笔转账怎么还没到？你确定账号没填错吧？
en: Why hasn't the transfer gone through yet? You did put the right account number in, didn't you?
alt: How come the transfer still hasn't arrived? Are you sure you used the right account number?
point: “还没到”用 hasn't … yet；“确定…吧”用 did…, didn't you?

zh: 你一般几点下班？
en: What time do you usually finish work?
alt: When do you normally knock off?
point: 下班说 finish work，Kiwi 口语 knock off；别漏 do

zh: 这是谁的笔记本？
en: Whose laptop is this?
point: “谁的”用 Whose + 名词，不要写成 Who's laptop

zh: 你想喝点什么？
en: What would you like to drink?
alt: What can I get you to drink?
point: 点单时问“想要什么”用 would you like，比 do you want 礼貌

zh: 你支持哪个队？
en: Which team do you support?
alt: Who do you support?
point: 支持球队用 support；Which team 后仍要 do you

zh: 这个打完折是多少钱？
en: How much is this after the discount?
alt: What's the sale price on this?
point: “打完折”说 after the discount；How much is 不说 How much money

zh: 你的航班几点落地？
en: What time does your flight land?
alt: When does your flight get in?
point: 落地说 land / get in；What time 后要加 does

zh: 你感冒好点了吗？
en: Is your cold any better?
alt: Are you feeling any better?
point: “好点了吗”说 Is it any better?，不说 Is your cold good a little

zh: 今晚谁做饭？
en: Who's cooking tonight?
alt: Who's making dinner tonight?
point: 问主语直接 Who's cooking，已安排的事用进行时

zh: 你们俩是怎么认识的？
en: How did you two meet?
alt: How did you guys meet?
point: “怎么认识的”用 meet，不说 How did you know each other

zh: 这张卡怎么激活？
en: How do I activate this card?
alt: How do I get this card activated?
point: “怎么做某事”说 How do I…?，主语 I 和 do 都不能省

zh: 你简历投了吗？
en: Have you sent in your CV?
alt: Have you applied yet?
point: 投简历说 send in your CV；“…了吗”用 Have you…?

zh: 面试是几号？
en: When's the interview?
alt: What date is the interview?
point: “几号”问日期用 When / What date，不说 What number

zh: 你为什么想辞职？
en: Why do you want to quit?
alt: Why are you thinking of leaving?
point: Why 后要 do you want；辞职口语说 quit 或 leave

zh: 你在学什么专业？
en: What are you studying?
alt: What's your major?
point: “学什么专业”NZ 口语说 What are you studying?

zh: 昨天的考试难不难？
en: Was yesterday's exam hard?
alt: Was the exam tough yesterday?
point: “难不难”是一般疑问 Was it hard?；昨天要用过去式

zh: 图书馆开到几点？
en: How late is the library open?
alt: What time does the library close?
point: “开到几点”说 How late is it open?

zh: 房租包不包水电？
en: Does the rent include power and water?
alt: Are bills included in the rent?
point: “包不包”用 Does … include…?；电在 NZ 常说 power

zh: 你哪天搬进来？
en: When are you moving in?
alt: What day are you moving in?
point: 定好的计划用进行时 When are you moving in?

zh: 你的押金退回来了吗？
en: Did you get your bond back?
alt: Have you got your bond back yet?
point: “押金退回来了”换主语：get your bond back；押金 NZ 叫 bond

zh: 这是你家的猫吗？
en: Is this your cat?
alt: Does this cat belong to you?
point: “你家的”直接用 your，不说 your family's

zh: 隔壁新搬来的是谁？
en: Who's moved in next door?
alt: Who are the new people next door?
point: 问主语 Who's moved in，用现在完成时

zh: 昨晚那声巨响你听到了吗？
en: Did you hear that loud bang last night?
alt: Did you hear that crash last night?
point: 巨响说 bang；宾语提前的中文要还原成 Did you hear…

zh: 你们那边也停电了吗？
en: Is your power out too?
alt: Have you lost power as well?
point: 停电说 the power's out，不说 stop electricity

zh: 你用的是哪家的网？
en: Who's your internet provider?
alt: Who are you with for broadband?
point: 问用哪家公司说 Who are you with?，不说 Which home's internet

zh: 上个月电费多少？
en: How much was last month's power bill?
alt: What did the power bill come to last month?
point: 电费是 power bill；上个月用过去式 was

zh: 修这个要多少钱？
en: How much will it cost to fix this?
alt: How much would it be to repair this?
point: “要多少钱”说 How much will it cost to…，主语用 it

zh: 水管工几点来？
en: What time's the plumber coming?
alt: When's the plumber due?
point: 安排好的事用进行时 is coming，不说 What time plumber come

zh: 洗衣机又坏了？
en: Has the washing machine broken down again?
alt: Is the washing machine broken again?
point: 机器坏了说 break down；“又…了”用 Has … again?

zh: 这张表要填几份？
en: How many copies of this form do I fill in?
alt: How many of these forms do I need to fill out?
point: How many 后接复数名词；填表说 fill in

zh: 你的签证什么时候到期？
en: When does your visa expire?
alt: When does your visa run out?
point: 到期说 expire / run out，别漏 does

zh: 在哪儿签字？
en: Where do I sign?
alt: Where should I sign?
point: 中文省了主语，英文要说 Where do I sign?

zh: 有人受伤吗？
en: Is anyone hurt?
alt: Has anyone been injured?
point: 疑问句用 anyone 不用 someone；受伤是 hurt 形容词

zh: 你没事吧？
en: Are you all right?
alt: You OK?
point: “没事吧”说 Are you all right?，不说 No problem?

zh: 你报警了没有？
en: Have you called the police?
alt: Did you ring 111?
point: 报警说 call the police / ring 111，不说 report police

zh: 你的车什么时候该做WOF？
en: When's your car due for a WOF?
alt: When does your WOF run out?
point: “该做…了”说 be due for，不说 should do WOF

zh: 这儿能停车吗？
en: Can I park here?
alt: Am I allowed to park here?
point: 中文省主语，英文要说 Can I park here?

zh: 你开车去还是坐公交？
en: Are you driving or taking the bus?
alt: Will you drive or catch the bus?
point: 选择疑问 A or B，坐公交说 take / catch the bus

zh: 明天会下雨吗？
en: Is it going to rain tomorrow?
alt: Will it rain tomorrow?
point: 天气要用主语 it：Is it going to rain?

zh: 这条步道走完要多久？
en: How long does this track take?
alt: How long does it take to walk this track?
point: 步道 NZ 叫 track；“要多久”用 How long does … take

zh: 你带防晒霜了吗？
en: Did you bring any sunscreen?
alt: Have you got sunblock?
point: “带了吗”说 Did you bring / Have you got，疑问句用 any

zh: 你平时有空喜欢干什么？
en: What do you like doing in your spare time?
alt: What do you do for fun?
point: “有空时”说 in your spare time；What 后要加 do you

zh: 这部电影你看过没有？
en: Have you seen this movie?
alt: Have you watched this film before?
point: “看过没有”用现在完成 Have you seen…?

zh: 那本书怎么样？
en: What was the book like?
alt: How did you find the book?
point: 问感受用 What was … like?，不说 How about the book

zh: 你们春节一般怎么过？
en: How do you usually celebrate Chinese New Year?
alt: What do you normally do for Chinese New Year?
point: 过节说 celebrate 或 do for，不说 pass the festival

zh: 她生日是哪天？
en: When's her birthday?
alt: What date is her birthday?
point: “哪天”说 When，不说 Which day is her birthday

zh: 我们送他们什么礼物好？
en: What should we get them?
alt: What should we give them as a present?
point: 送礼口语说 get someone something，不说 send gift

zh: 你家孩子几岁了？
en: How old are your kids?
alt: How old are your children now?
point: “几岁”用 How old；孩子复数用 are

zh: 今天谁去接孩子？
en: Who's picking the kids up today?
alt: Who's collecting the kids today?
point: 接孩子说 pick up；问主语不加 does

zh: 你爸妈身体都还好吧？
en: Are your parents keeping well?
alt: How are your mum and dad doing?
point: 问候长辈身体说 Are they keeping well?

zh: 你家狗叫什么名字？
en: What's your dog called?
alt: What's your dog's name?
point: “叫什么”说 What's it called?，不说 How is it called

zh: 我能摸摸它吗？
en: Can I give him a pat?
alt: Is it OK if I pat her?
point: 摸狗说 pat，不说 touch；宠物常用 him/her

zh: 你的猫打过疫苗吗？
en: Has your cat had its vaccinations?
alt: Is your cat vaccinated?
point: 打疫苗说 have its vaccinations，不说 hit vaccine

zh: 你是不是生我气了？
en: Are you angry with me?
alt: Are you mad at me?
point: 生某人的气说 angry with / mad at，“是不是”就是一般疑问

zh: 你怎么哭了？
en: Why are you crying?
alt: What's made you cry?
point: “怎么哭了”问原因用 Why，正在发生用进行时

zh: 你什么事这么开心？
en: What are you so happy about?
alt: Why are you so cheerful?
point: What are you … about? 介词 about 放句末

zh: 你能告诉我这台打印机怎么用吗？我今天第一天上班。
en: Can you show me how this printer works? It's my first day.
alt: Could you show me how to use the printer? I only started today.
point: 间接疑问 how this printer works，不说 how does it work

zh: 你的电脑是从什么时候开始变慢的？
en: When did your computer start running slowly?
alt: How long has your laptop been this slow?
point: 问开始时间 When did … start + -ing，别漏 did

zh: 这个汤里有没有放花生？我朋友对花生过敏。
en: Does this soup have peanuts in it? My friend's allergic.
alt: Are there any nuts in this soup? My friend has a peanut allergy.
point: “有没有放”说 Does it have … in it?；过敏是 allergic

zh: 你跑一个半马一般要多长时间？
en: How long does it take you to run a half marathon?
alt: What's your usual half marathon time?
point: “你做…要多久”说 How long does it take you to…

zh: 这件外套还有别的颜色吗？黑色的有点太素了。
en: Does this jacket come in any other colours? Black's a bit plain.
alt: Have you got this coat in another colour? The black is a bit boring.
point: “有别的颜色吗”说 Does it come in…?；英式拼 colour

zh: 你订的酒店离市中心远不远？我们想走过去。
en: Is the hotel you booked far from the city centre? We'd like to walk.
alt: How far is your hotel from town? We're hoping to walk in.
point: “远不远”用 Is it far from…?，不说 far or not far

zh: 这个药是饭前吃还是饭后吃？
en: Do I take this before or after meals?
alt: Should I take these before or after food?
point: 选择疑问 before or after；吃药动词用 take

zh: 你把我的充电器借给谁了？我到处都找不到。
en: Who did you lend my charger to? I can't find it anywhere.
alt: Who's got my charger? It's not anywhere.
point: 问宾语 Who did you lend it to?，介词 to 放句末

zh: 你最近在忙什么？好久没见到你了。
en: What have you been up to lately? I haven't seen you for ages.
alt: What have you been doing with yourself? It's been ages.
point: “在忙什么”说 What have you been up to?

zh: 你每个月大概花多少钱在吃的上面？
en: Roughly how much do you spend on food each month?
alt: What's your monthly food budget, more or less?
point: “花钱在…上”说 spend on，How much 后要加 do you

zh: 你知道那份工作工资多少吗？广告上没写。
en: Do you know what the salary is for that job? The ad doesn't say.
alt: Any idea what that job pays? It's not in the ad.
point: 间接疑问 what the salary is，is 放后面

zh: 面试的时候他们都问了你些什么？难不难？
en: What did they ask you in the interview? Was it tough?
alt: What sort of questions did they ask? Was it hard?
point: 问宾语 What did they ask you?，要加 did

zh: 你不是上个月就递辞职信了吗？怎么还在这儿？
en: Didn't you hand in your notice last month? Why are you still here?
alt: I thought you resigned last month. How come you're still here?
point: 否定疑问 Didn't you…?；递辞职说 hand in your notice

zh: 你知道这份作业什么时候交吗？
en: Do you know when this assignment's due?
alt: Any idea when we have to hand this assignment in?
point: 间接疑问 when it's due；交作业的期限说 due

zh: 你的英语课一周上几次？晚上还是白天？
en: How often is your English class? Is it in the evening or during the day?
alt: How many classes a week do you have? Are they at night?
point: “一周几次”用 How often；选择疑问 in the evening or during the day

zh: 下学期的课你报了吗？截止日期快到了。
en: Have you enrolled for next semester yet? The deadline's coming up.
alt: Have you signed up for next semester's courses? Enrolments close soon.
point: 报名选课说 enrol（英式一个 l）；Have you … yet?

zh: 这套房子从什么时候开始可以入住？我们下个月要搬。
en: When is the house available from? We need to move next month.
alt: When can we move in? We have to be out of our place next month.
point: “什么时候可以入住”说 When is it available from?，from 放句末

zh: 你跟几个人合租？大家处得好吗？
en: How many flatmates have you got? Do you all get on?
alt: How many people do you share with? Do you get along?
point: 合租的人叫 flatmates；相处说 get on

zh: 中介有没有说下次检查是什么时候？
en: Did the property manager say when the next inspection is?
alt: Did the agent mention when they're doing the next inspection?
point: 间接疑问 when the next inspection is，is 放最后

zh: 你知道那辆白车是谁的吗？在我们门口停了三天了。
en: Do you know whose white car that is? It's been parked outside our place for three days.
alt: Any idea who owns that white car? It's been outside our house for three days.
point: 间接疑问 whose car that is，不说 whose is that car

zh: 你家狗昨晚是不是叫了一整夜？
en: Was your dog barking all night last night?
alt: Did your dog bark the whole night last night?
point: “是不是”就是一般疑问；持续的动作用过去进行时

zh: 你们在这条街住了很多年了吧？
en: You've lived on this street for years, haven't you?
alt: You've been on this street a long time, haven't you?
point: “…了吧”用反义疑问 haven't you?，住了多年用现在完成

zh: 你知道这次停电要停到几点吗？我手机快没电了。
en: Do you know how long the power will be off? My phone's nearly flat.
alt: Any idea when the power's coming back on? My phone's about to die.
point: 间接疑问 how long the power will be off；手机没电说 flat

zh: 这个月燃气费怎么这么贵？我们都没怎么用。
en: Why is the gas bill so high this month? We've hardly used any.
alt: How come the gas bill's so big this month? We barely used it.
point: Why is … so high?；“没怎么用”说 hardly used

zh: 你的手机套餐一个月多少钱？流量够用吗？
en: How much is your mobile plan a month? Do you get enough data?
alt: What do you pay for your phone plan? Is the data enough?
point: 流量说 data；“够用吗”说 Do you get enough…?

zh: 你认识靠谱的水管工吗？浴室的水龙头一直漏水。
en: Do you know a good plumber? Our bathroom tap keeps leaking.
alt: Can you recommend a reliable plumber? The bathroom tap won't stop dripping.
point: “认识靠谱的…吗”说 Do you know a good…?；“一直”用 keep + -ing

zh: 他们的报价里包不包括人工费？
en: Does their quote include labour?
alt: Is labour included in their quote?
point: 人工费说 labour（英式拼法）；“包不包括”用 Does … include?

zh: 冰箱怎么一直有响声？是不是哪里坏了？
en: Why does the fridge keep making that noise? Is something wrong with it?
alt: What's that noise the fridge keeps making? Is it broken?
point: Why does … keep -ing?；“哪里坏了”说 something wrong with it

zh: 你知道换新护照要多长时间吗？我下个月要回国。
en: Do you know how long it takes to renew a passport? I'm going home next month.
alt: Any idea how long a passport renewal takes? I'm flying home next month.
point: 间接疑问 how long it takes，不说 how long does it take

zh: 你的IRD号码批下来了没有？
en: Has your IRD number come through yet?
alt: Have you got your IRD number yet?
point: “批下来”说 come through；“了没有”用 Has … yet?

zh: 这张表是在网上填，还是要去邮局填？
en: Do I fill this form in online, or do I have to go to the post office?
alt: Is this form done online or at the post office?
point: 选择疑问两边都用疑问语序；fill in 可以拆开

zh: 你看清那个人往哪边跑了吗？
en: Did you see which way the guy ran?
alt: Did you notice which direction he went?
point: 间接疑问 which way he ran，不说 which way did he run

zh: 地震的时候你在哪儿？家里没事吧？
en: Where were you when the earthquake hit? Is your place OK?
alt: Where were you during the quake? Was there any damage at home?
point: 地震“发生”说 hit；问过去的位置用 Where were you

zh: 你什么时候发现钱包不见的？
en: When did you realise your wallet was missing?
alt: When did you notice your wallet had gone?
point: “发现不见”说 realise … was missing；英式拼 realise

zh: 你今年的rego续了吗？快到期了吧？
en: Have you renewed your rego this year? It's nearly due, isn't it?
alt: Did you renew your rego? It runs out soon, doesn't it?
point: 续 rego 说 renew；“…吧”用反义疑问 isn't it?

zh: 开车去惠灵顿要几个小时？中途要加油吗？
en: How many hours is the drive to Wellington? Will we need to stop for petrol?
alt: How long does it take to drive to Wellington? Do we need to fill up on the way?
point: 车程说 the drive；中途加油说 stop for petrol

zh: 你为什么不坐火车上班？不是更快吗？
en: Why don't you take the train to work? Isn't it quicker?
alt: How come you don't catch the train? Wouldn't it be faster?
point: 否定疑问 Isn't it…? 表示“不是…吗”

zh: 你觉得这周末的天气适合去露营吗？
en: Do you think the weather will be OK for camping this weekend?
alt: Reckon the weather's good enough for camping this weekend?
point: Do you think 后用陈述语序 the weather will be

zh: 这片海滩能游泳吗？我看浪挺大的。
en: Is this beach safe for swimming? The waves look pretty big.
alt: Is it safe to swim here? The surf looks quite rough.
point: “能游泳吗”问安全说 Is it safe to swim?

zh: 你上次去徒步是什么时候？我快一年没去了。
en: When did you last go tramping? I haven't been for nearly a year.
alt: When was the last time you went tramping? It's been almost a year for me.
point: “上次…是什么时候”说 When did you last…?；徒步 NZ 叫 tramping

zh: 你一般在哪儿剪头发？多少钱一次？
en: Where do you usually get your hair cut? How much do they charge?
alt: Where do you go for haircuts? What do they charge?
point: 剪头发是别人剪，说 get your hair cut

zh: 你最近在追什么剧？有好看的吗？
en: What are you watching at the moment? Anything good?
alt: What shows are you into right now? Any good ones?
point: 追剧就说 watch；“有好看的吗”口语 Anything good?

zh: 演唱会的票你抢到了吗？听说几分钟就卖光了。
en: Did you manage to get concert tickets? I heard they sold out in minutes.
alt: Did you get tickets for the concert? Apparently they went in a few minutes.
point: “抢到”说 manage to get；卖光是 sell out

zh: 去婚礼要穿正装吗？请柬上没写。
en: Do we need to dress up for the wedding? The invitation doesn't say.
alt: Is the wedding formal? It doesn't say on the invite.
point: “穿正装”说 dress up；“要…吗”用 Do we need to…?

zh: 你们家圣诞节一般吃什么？
en: What does your family usually eat at Christmas?
alt: What do you normally have for Christmas lunch?
point: your family 是单数，用 does

zh: 今年中秋你回国过吗？
en: Are you going home for the Mid-Autumn Festival this year?
alt: Will you go back to China for Mid-Autumn this year?
point: 回国过节说 go home for；计划用进行时

zh: 你女儿上的是哪所学校？离家近吗？
en: Which school does your daughter go to? Is it close to home?
alt: What school is your daughter at? Is it near you?
point: 上学说 go to，介词 to 放句末

zh: 你爸妈这次来新西兰待多久？
en: How long are your parents staying in New Zealand this time?
alt: How long are your mum and dad here for this time?
point: 已定的计划用进行时 How long are they staying?

zh: 你们家平时谁做饭多一点？
en: Who does most of the cooking in your house?
alt: Who usually cooks at your place?
point: 问主语 Who does…，不说 Who does do

zh: 你出去旅游的时候谁帮你喂猫？
en: Who feeds your cat when you're away?
alt: Who looks after your cat when you go on holiday?
point: 问主语 Who feeds…；“出门在外”说 be away

zh: 你家狗一天要遛几次？
en: How many times a day do you walk your dog?
alt: How often does your dog need walking?
point: 遛狗说 walk the dog，不说 slip the dog

zh: 兽医有没有说它是什么毛病？
en: Did the vet say what's wrong with him?
alt: Did the vet tell you what the problem is?
point: 间接疑问 what's wrong with him，不倒装

zh: 你今天怎么闷闷不乐的？出什么事了吗？
en: How come you're so down today? Has something happened?
alt: Why are you so quiet today? Is something wrong?
point: How come 后接陈述语序 you're；闷闷不乐说 down

zh: 他那样说你，你都不生气吗？
en: Didn't it bother you when he said that?
alt: Weren't you annoyed when he talked to you like that?
point: “你都不…吗”用否定疑问 Didn't it…?

zh: 你还在为昨天的事生我的气吗？
en: Are you still upset with me about yesterday?
alt: Are you still annoyed about what happened yesterday?
point: “为…生气”说 upset about；still 放 are you 后面

zh: 你觉得谁会接Mike的位子？他下个月就走了。
en: Who do you think will take over from Mike? He's leaving next month.
alt: Who's going to replace Mike, do you reckon? He finishes up next month.
point: 插入 do you think 后用陈述语序：Who do you think will…

zh: 这个会还要开多久？我两点还有个电话要打。
en: How much longer is this meeting going to go on? I've got a call at two.
alt: How much longer will this meeting take? I've got a phone call at two.
point: “还要多久”说 How much longer，不说 How long still

zh: 这个月的周报是轮到我写了，对吧？
en: It's my turn to do the weekly report this month, isn't it?
alt: I'm on the weekly report this month, aren't I?
point: 陈述句 + 反义疑问 isn't it? 用来确认，不说 right or not

zh: 你还记得Wi-Fi密码是多少吗？我忘了写在哪儿了。
en: Can you remember what the Wi-Fi password is? I've forgotten where I wrote it down.
alt: Do you know the Wi-Fi password off the top of your head? I can't find where I put it.
point: 间接疑问 what the password is，is 放句末

zh: 这个按钮是干什么用的？我按了好像什么反应都没有。
en: What's this button for? I pressed it and nothing seemed to happen.
alt: What does this button do? Nothing happened when I clicked it.
point: “干什么用的”说 What's it for?，for 放句末

zh: 你手机里的照片备份过没有？万一手机丢了就全没了。
en: Have you ever backed up the photos on your phone? You'd lose the lot if it went missing.
alt: Are your phone photos backed up anywhere? If you lost your phone they'd be gone.
point: Have you ever…? 问有没有做过；备份是 back up

zh: 你在这家公司干了多久了？有没有想过换个工作？
en: How long have you been at this company? Have you ever thought about moving on?
alt: How long have you worked there? Ever thought about looking for something else?
point: How long have you been… 用现在完成；换工作说 move on

zh: 他们有没有说什么时候给你答复？都过了一个星期了。
en: Did they say when they'd get back to you? It's been a week already.
alt: Did they mention when you'd hear back? It's already been a week.
point: 间接疑问随 did 后移时态：when they'd get back to you

zh: 你打算找谁做推荐人？最好是以前的经理。
en: Who are you going to put down as a referee? Ideally it should be a former manager.
alt: Who are you using as your referees? A previous manager would be best.
point: 推荐人 NZ 叫 referee；put down as 的介词别漏

zh: 你觉得这门课值得读吗？学费可不便宜。
en: Do you think this course is worth doing? The fees aren't cheap.
alt: Is this course worth it, do you reckon? It's not cheap.
point: “值得…吗”说 Is it worth doing?，worth 后用 -ing

zh: 你知道哪里有免费的英语课吗？我朋友刚来新西兰。
en: Do you know where I can find free English classes? My friend's just moved to New Zealand.
alt: Do you know anywhere that runs free English lessons? My mate's only just arrived in New Zealand.
point: 间接疑问 where I can find，can 不提前

zh: 你雅思考了几次才过的？
en: How many times did you sit IELTS before you passed?
alt: How many goes did it take you to pass IELTS?
point: 参加考试英式说 sit an exam；“几次才…”用 before you passed

zh: 冰箱里那盒剩饭是谁的？还有人要吗？
en: Whose leftovers are those in the fridge? Does anyone still want them?
alt: Who do the leftovers in the fridge belong to? Is anyone going to eat them?
point: Whose + 名词；疑问句里用 anyone，不用 someone

zh: 回收垃圾是星期几收？我们这周好像忘了把桶推出去。
en: Which day is the recycling collected? I think we forgot to put the bin out this week.
alt: What day's recycling day? I don't think we put the bin out this week.
point: 被动疑问 is it collected；放垃圾桶说 put the bin out

zh: 你不是说今天要剪草吗？怎么还没动？
en: Weren't you going to mow the lawns today? How come you haven't started?
alt: I thought you were mowing the lawns today. Why haven't you started yet?
point: “不是说要…吗”用 Weren't you going to…?

zh: 看房的时候你问了没有，那里是用什么取暖的？冬天会不会冷？
en: When you viewed the flat, did you ask what kind of heating it has? Will it be cold in winter?
alt: Did you find out what heating the flat has at the viewing? Is it going to be cold in winter?
point: 间接疑问 what kind of heating it has，不倒装

zh: 你想要大一点的卧室，还是带独立卫浴的那间？
en: Would you rather have the bigger bedroom or the one with the ensuite?
alt: Do you want the bigger room or the room with its own bathroom?
point: “想要A还是B”用 Would you rather…?；独立卫浴是 ensuite

zh: 下个月开始房租要涨了，你听说了吗？
en: Have you heard the rent's going up from next month?
alt: Did you hear they're putting the rent up next month?
point: Have you heard + 陈述句；涨房租说 go up / put up

zh: 你知道是谁老把车停在我们车道口吗？
en: Do you know who keeps parking across our driveway?
alt: Any idea who keeps blocking our driveway?
point: 间接疑问问主语 who keeps parking，语序不变

zh: 你家的树都伸到我们这边来了，你们打算修一下吗？
en: Your tree's hanging over our fence. Are you planning to trim it back at some point?
alt: Your tree's grown over onto our side. Were you thinking of cutting it back?
point: “打算…吗”说 Are you planning to…?；修剪树枝 trim back

zh: 这周末街区搞清洁活动，你去不去？
en: There's a street clean-up this weekend. Are you coming along?
alt: Are you going to the neighbourhood clean-up this weekend?
point: 问对方是否参加说 Are you coming along?，不说 go or not go

zh: 你家宽带合约什么时候到期？到期了能换别家吗？
en: When does your broadband contract end? Can you switch providers after that?
alt: When's your internet contract up? Are you free to change companies then?
point: 换供应商说 switch providers；合约到期说 end / be up

zh: 我们的水费是按用量算，还是每个月固定的？
en: Is our water bill based on how much we use, or is it a fixed amount?
alt: Do we pay for water by usage, or is it a flat rate?
point: 选择疑问后半句也要完整：or is it…

zh: 你给网络公司打电话了吗？他们说什么时候能修好？
en: Have you rung the internet company? Did they say when it'll be fixed?
alt: Did you call the provider? When did they say it'd be back up?
point: 间接疑问 when it'll be fixed，被动 be fixed

zh: 电工有没有说到底是什么原因导致的？
en: Did the electrician say what was actually causing the problem?
alt: Did the sparky work out what the problem was?
point: 间接疑问 what was causing…；“到底”用 actually；电工 Kiwi 叫 sparky

zh: 这个漏水的水龙头你自己能修吗，还是得叫人来？
en: Can you fix this leaky tap yourself, or do we need to get someone in?
alt: Is this dripping tap a DIY job, or should we call someone?
point: 叫人上门修说 get someone in；选择疑问后半要 do we

zh: 你到目前为止拿到几个报价了？哪个最划算？
en: How many quotes have you got so far? Which one's the best value?
alt: How many quotes have come in? Which is the best deal?
point: 到目前为止用现在完成 have got so far；划算 best value

zh: 这个保修多久？坏了能直接换新的吗？
en: How long is the warranty on this? If it breaks, can I just swap it for a new one?
alt: How long's it guaranteed for? Can I get a replacement if it stops working?
point: 保修说 warranty；换新的说 swap it for a new one

zh: 你这件毛衣在哪儿买的？我也想买一件。
en: Where did you get that jumper? I'd love one like it.
alt: Where's your jumper from? I want one too.
point: 毛衣 NZ 说 jumper；买东西口语用 get

zh: 我的网购订单怎么显示已经送达了？我什么都没收到啊。
en: Why does my order say it's been delivered when I haven't received anything?
alt: How come it says my parcel's been delivered? Nothing's turned up.
point: Why does … say…?；when 在这里表示“可是”

zh: 你们这儿可以自带酒吗？开瓶费多少？
en: Is this place BYO? How much do you charge for corkage?
alt: Can we bring our own wine? What's the corkage?
point: 自带酒水 NZ 说 BYO；开瓶费是 corkage

zh: 今天的例汤是什么？里面有奶吗？
en: What's the soup of the day? Has it got any dairy in it?
alt: What's today's soup? Is it dairy-free?
point: Has it got … in it? 问成分；奶制品统称 dairy

zh: 你们是不是把我们的单搞混了？这不是我们点的。
en: Have you mixed up our order? This isn't what we ordered.
alt: I think our order's got mixed up. This isn't ours, is it?
point: 搞混说 mix up；what we ordered 用陈述语序

zh: 你知道怎么查KiwiSaver余额吗？我从来没看过。
en: Do you know how to check your KiwiSaver balance? I've never looked at mine.
alt: How do you find out what's in your KiwiSaver? I've never checked.
point: 间接疑问 how to check；余额说 balance

zh: 这笔钱是谁转给我的？备注里什么都没写。
en: Who sent me this money? There's nothing in the reference.
alt: Who's transferred this into my account? The reference is blank.
point: 问主语 Who sent，不加 did；转账备注叫 reference

zh: 你觉得我们应该先还贷款，还是先存钱？
en: Do you think we should pay off the loan first, or save up instead?
alt: Should we focus on paying off the loan, or on saving, do you reckon?
point: Do you think 后接陈述语序 we should；还清是 pay off

zh: 你知道去哪儿找太平绅士给文件做公证吗？
en: Do you know where I can get a document certified by a JP?
alt: Any idea where I can find a JP to certify some documents?
point: 使役结构 get a document certified；间接疑问不倒装

zh: 我得先预约，还是直接过去就行？
en: Do I need to make an appointment, or can I just walk in?
alt: Is it by appointment only, or can I just turn up?
point: 选择疑问两半都倒装；不预约直接去说 walk in

zh: 你记得自己的护照号码吗？表上要填。
en: Do you know your passport number off by heart? The form's asking for it.
alt: Can you remember your passport number? We need it for the form.
point: “背得出”说 know off by heart；表格要求填说 ask for

zh: 你上次看牙医是多久以前了？
en: How long ago did you last see a dentist?
alt: When was the last time you went to the dentist?
point: “多久以前”说 How long ago，别漏 did

zh: 你在GP那儿登记了吗？听说现在新病人很难排上。
en: Have you enrolled with a GP yet? I've heard it's hard to get in as a new patient.
alt: Are you registered with a doctor yet? Apparently a lot of practices aren't taking new patients.
point: 登记家庭医生说 enrol with a GP；Have you … yet?

zh: 这个处方要拿去哪家药房配？
en: Which pharmacy do I take this prescription to?
alt: Where should I get this prescription filled?
point: 介词 to 放句末；配药也可说 get it filled

zh: 你家准备地震应急包了没有？
en: Have you got an emergency kit ready in case of an earthquake?
alt: Is your earthquake kit sorted?
point: Have you got … ready? 问准备好没；以防说 in case of

zh: 你还记得车牌号是多少吗？警察肯定会问。
en: Can you remember what the number plate was? The police will want to know.
alt: Did you get the rego number? The police are bound to ask.
point: 车牌是 number plate；间接疑问 what … was 放句末

zh: 火警响了，我们是不是应该走楼梯？
en: The fire alarm's going off. Shouldn't we take the stairs?
alt: The fire alarm's gone off. Shouldn't we be using the stairs?
point: 否定疑问 Shouldn't we…? 表建议；警报响说 go off

zh: 你的车在哪儿做的WOF？他们收你多少钱？
en: Where did you get your WOF done? How much did they charge you?
alt: Where do you take your car for its WOF? What do they charge?
point: 使役 get … done；收费用 charge

zh: 坐哪路车能到医院？中间要换车吗？
en: Which bus goes to the hospital? Do I need to change?
alt: What bus do I get to the hospital? Is there a transfer?
point: 问主语 Which bus goes，不加 does；换乘说 change

zh: 你的车是自动挡还是手动挡？我只会开自动的。
en: Is your car an automatic or a manual? I can only drive automatics.
alt: Is your car auto or manual? I can't drive a stick shift.
point: 选择疑问 an automatic or a manual；“只会开”用 can only

zh: 你去过南岛没有？最推荐哪儿？
en: Have you ever been to the South Island? Where would you recommend?
alt: Have you been down south? What's the best place to go?
point: 去过说 have been to，不说 have gone to

zh: 这趟航班行李能带几公斤？
en: How many kilos of luggage can I take on this flight?
alt: What's the baggage allowance on this flight?
point: How many kilos；行李限额也可说 baggage allowance

zh: 还没到入住时间，我们能先把行李放在前台吗？
en: Can we leave our bags at reception before we check in?
alt: Is it possible to drop our bags off before check-in?
point: 寄存行李说 leave our bags；before 后用现在时 check in

zh: 这条步道的小屋要提前订吗？还是到了再说？
en: Do we need to book the huts on this track ahead of time, or can we just turn up?
alt: Do the huts on this track have to be booked, or is it first come, first served?
point: 直接去说 just turn up；提前说 ahead of time

zh: 你觉得这场雨会下到什么时候？
en: How long do you reckon this rain will last?
alt: When do you think this rain will clear?
point: 插入 do you reckon 后用陈述语序 this rain will last

zh: 这么大的鱼你是在哪儿钓到的？
en: Where did you catch a fish that big?
alt: Where on earth did you catch such a big fish?
point: “这么大的鱼”说 a fish that big，形容词放后面

zh: 你打板球打了多少年了？是小时候就开始的吗？
en: How long have you been playing cricket? Did you start when you were a kid?
alt: How many years have you played cricket for? Did you pick it up as a child?
point: 一直在做的事用现在完成进行 How long have you been playing

zh: 周六的比赛几点开球？我们在哪儿集合？
en: What time's kick-off on Saturday, and where are we meeting?
alt: When does Saturday's game start, and where should we meet?
point: 开球说 kick-off；已约好的集合用进行时 are we meeting

zh: 你不是最讨厌跑步吗？怎么去报马拉松了？
en: Don't you hate running? What made you sign up for a marathon?
alt: I thought you hated running. Why did you enter a marathon?
point: What made you…? 问原因比 why 更自然；报名 sign up for

zh: 这个读书会多久聚一次？新人可以加入吗？
en: How often does the book club meet? Can new people join?
alt: How often do you get together? Is the club open to new members?
point: book club 是单数主语，用 does

zh: 那部电影的结局你怎么看？我到现在还没想明白。
en: What did you make of the ending? I still can't work it out.
alt: What did you think of how it ended? I'm still confused.
point: “怎么看”地道说法 What did you make of…?

zh: 你吉他是在哪儿学的？学了多久了？
en: Where did you learn guitar, and how long have you been playing?
alt: Who taught you guitar, and how long have you played for?
point: 学的地点用过去式；学了多久用现在完成进行

zh: 你是不是剪头发了？看起来不太一样。
en: Have you had a haircut? You look different.
alt: Have you done something different with your hair?
point: “剪头发了”说 Have you had a haircut?，不是自己剪

zh: 我们上次见面是什么时候来着？感觉好久了。
en: When did we last catch up? It feels like ages ago.
alt: When was the last time we got together? It seems like forever.
point: “…来着”回想用 When did we last…?；见面聚聚 catch up

zh: 你不是说要来吗？怎么最后没来？
en: Weren't you meant to be coming? What happened?
alt: I thought you were coming. What happened to you?
point: Weren't you meant to…? 表示“不是说好要…吗”

zh: 你知道他们婚礼的礼物清单上还剩什么吗？
en: Do you know what's left on their wedding registry?
alt: Any idea what's still on their gift list for the wedding?
point: 间接疑问 what's left；礼物清单叫 registry

zh: 今年圣诞你们在家过，还是出去玩？
en: Are you spending Christmas at home this year, or going away?
alt: Are you staying home for Christmas, or heading away somewhere?
point: 过节说 spend Christmas；外出度假说 go away

zh: 你还记得这个花瓶是谁送的吗？我想写张感谢卡。
en: Do you remember who gave us this vase? I want to write a thank-you card.
alt: Can you remember who the vase was from? I'd like to send a thank-you note.
point: 间接疑问问主语 who gave us，语序不变

zh: 你家孩子几点睡？会不会闹着不睡？
en: What time do your kids go to bed? Do they put up a fight?
alt: When do your kids go to sleep? Do they kick up a fuss?
point: “闹着不睡”说 put up a fight，不说 make noise

zh: 学校的家长会是哪天？你去还是我去？
en: When's the parent-teacher interview? Are you going or am I?
alt: What day is parent-teacher night? Is it you or me going?
point: 家长会 NZ 叫 parent-teacher interview；Are you going or am I?

zh: 你小时候爸妈管你管得严吗？
en: Were your parents strict when you were growing up?
alt: Were your mum and dad strict with you as a kid?
point: “小时候”说 when you were growing up；管得严 strict

zh: 你家狗做绝育了吗？还是你打算让它生小狗？
en: Has your dog been desexed, or are you planning to breed from her?
alt: Is your dog desexed, or are you thinking of letting her have puppies?
point: 被动疑问 Has it been desexed?；NZ 常用 desexed

zh: 这个公园里狗可以不拴绳吗？
en: Are dogs allowed off the lead in this park?
alt: Is this an off-leash park?
point: 不拴绳说 off the lead；“可以…吗”问规定用 Are … allowed?

zh: 你当初为什么选择养猫，而不是养狗？
en: Why did you go for a cat rather than a dog?
alt: What made you get a cat instead of a dog?
point: “选择”口语说 go for；A rather than B

zh: 你到底在担心什么？说出来可能会好受一点。
en: What are you actually worried about? It might help to talk about it.
alt: What's really bothering you? Talking about it might make you feel better.
point: 介词 about 放句末；“到底”用 actually

zh: 你是不是觉得我太敏感了？说实话。
en: Do you think I'm being too sensitive? Be honest.
alt: Am I overreacting, do you think? Tell me the truth.
point: Do you think 后用陈述语序；being 表示一时的表现

zh: 你怎么知道我心情不好？我什么都没说啊。
en: How did you know I was in a bad mood? I didn't say anything.
alt: How could you tell I was feeling down? I never said a word.
point: 宾语从句随主句变过去：I was in a bad mood

zh: 你看有没有可能把截止日期往后推几天？测试那边到现在还没给反馈。
en: Do you think there's any chance we could push the deadline back a few days? We still haven't heard back from testing.
alt: Is there any way we could move the deadline out by a few days? Testing still hasn't got back to us.
point: 委婉试探用 Do you think there's any chance…；推迟说 push back

zh: 你还记得我们当初为什么决定不用云存储吗？老板今天又问起来了。
en: Can you remember why we decided against cloud storage in the first place? The boss was asking about it again today.
alt: Do you remember what our reason was for not going with cloud storage? The boss brought it up again today.
point: 间接疑问 why we decided；决定不用说 decide against

zh: 周六晚上七点左右，我们十二个人，你们能安排得下吗？其中有两个是小孩。
en: Would you be able to fit twelve of us in around seven on Saturday night? Two of them are kids.
alt: Have you got room for a group of twelve at about seven on Saturday? That includes two children.
point: 订位问能否安排说 Would you be able to fit us in?

zh: 你知道俱乐部今年的会费涨了多少吗？还是跟去年一样？
en: Do you know how much the club fees have gone up this year, or are they the same as last year?
alt: Have the club subs gone up this year, do you know, or are they the same as before?
point: 间接疑问 how much … have gone up；后半句恢复正常疑问语序

zh: 我上周在你们网站下的单，到现在还没发货，能帮我查查是怎么回事吗？
en: I placed an order on your website last week and it still hasn't shipped. Could you find out what's going on?
alt: My online order from last week hasn't been sent yet. Can you check what's happening with it?
point: 间接疑问 what's going on；下单说 place an order

zh: 如果我们的第一段航班延误，赶不上转机，航空公司会帮我们改签吗？
en: If our first flight's delayed and we miss the connection, will the airline rebook us onto another one?
alt: What happens if we miss our connecting flight because of a delay? Does the airline sort out a new booking?
point: if 从句用现在时，主句问 will…?；改签是 rebook

zh: 这个药能跟我平时吃的降压药一起吃吗？还是要隔开一段时间？
en: Is it OK to take this alongside my blood pressure tablets, or should I leave a gap between them?
alt: Can I take this with my blood pressure medication, or do I need to space them out?
point: Is it OK to…, or should I…? 选择疑问；隔开吃说 leave a gap

zh: 你周末有没有空帮我把这个衣柜装起来？说明书我看了半天也没看懂。
en: Any chance you're free this weekend to help me put this wardrobe together? I can't make head or tail of the instructions.
alt: Are you around this weekend to help me assemble this wardrobe? The instructions make no sense to me.
point: 口语省略问法 Any chance…?；组装说 put together

zh: 你还记得我们以前常去的那家咖啡馆叫什么吗？我想带朋友去。
en: Do you remember what that café we used to go to was called? I want to take a friend there.
alt: What was the name of that café we always used to go to? I'd like to take a mate.
point: 间接疑问 what … was called，be called 放句末

zh: 你知道从中国汇钱过来最划算的方式是什么吗？银行的汇率好像不太好。
en: Do you know what the cheapest way is to transfer money from China? The bank's exchange rate doesn't seem great.
alt: What's the best way to send money over from China, do you know? The bank's rate isn't very good.
point: 间接疑问 what the cheapest way is，is 不能提前

zh: 我想问一下，这个职位是长期的还是合同制的？如果是合同，大概多长时间？
en: Could I ask whether this role is permanent or fixed-term, and if it's a contract, roughly how long it'd be for?
alt: Can I check if this is a permanent position or a fixed-term contract, and how long the contract would run?
point: 间接疑问 whether A or B / how long it'd be for，不倒装

zh: 他们问你为什么离开上一家公司的时候，你是怎么回答的？
en: When they asked you why you'd left your last job, how did you answer that one?
alt: How did you handle the question about why you left your previous job?
point: 嵌套的间接疑问 why you'd left 用陈述语序

zh: 你不觉得这个工资比市场价低吗？我觉得你可以再谈一谈。
en: Don't you think that salary's a bit below market rate? I reckon you could try negotiating.
alt: Isn't that offer on the low side for the market? You could probably push for more.
point: 否定疑问 Don't you think…?；市场价说 market rate

zh: 你知道期末考试是开卷还是闭卷吗？老师上课好像没说清楚。
en: Do you know if the final exam is open-book or closed-book? The tutor didn't really make it clear in class.
alt: Is the final exam open-book, do you know? The lecturer wasn't very clear about it.
point: 间接疑问 if it's A or B；说清楚说 make it clear

zh: 你觉得我是先读个英语预科好，还是直接申请硕士？
en: Do you think I'd be better off doing a foundation English course first, or should I apply straight for a master's?
alt: Would it make more sense to do a foundation course first, or to go straight into a master's?
point: “…比较好”说 be better off doing；选择疑问后半句用 should I

zh: 这篇论文有没有办法延期交？我这周家里出了点事。
en: Is there any way I could get an extension on this essay? Something's come up at home this week.
alt: Would it be possible to have a few more days for this essay? I've had a family issue this week.
point: 委婉问可能性 Is there any way I could…?；延期是 extension

zh: 想问一下，墙上那几个钉子眼，搬走的时候会不会从押金里扣钱？
en: Just wondering, will they deduct anything from the bond for the nail holes in the wall when we move out?
alt: Do you think we'll lose some of our bond for those nail holes when we leave?
point: Just wondering 开头软化提问；从押金扣钱说 deduct from the bond

zh: 你签租约之前，有没有仔细看关于养宠物和转租的条款？
en: Before you signed the tenancy agreement, did you read the bits about pets and subletting properly?
alt: Did you go through the pet and subletting clauses carefully before you signed the lease?
point: 租约 NZ 说 tenancy agreement；properly 放句末

zh: 这套房子我们挺喜欢的，请问怎么申请？需要提供哪些材料？
en: We really like the place. How do we go about applying, and what documents do you need from us?
alt: We're keen on this one. What's the application process, and what paperwork should we send?
point: “怎么着手做”说 How do we go about -ing?

zh: 不好意思打扰一下，你们今晚的派对大概几点结束？我家宝宝九点就要睡了。
en: Sorry to bother you, but roughly what time do you think the party will wind down tonight? Our baby goes to bed at nine.
alt: Sorry to be a pain, but when's the party likely to finish tonight? Our baby sleeps from nine.
point: what time do you think 后陈述语序；派对收尾说 wind down

zh: 你在附近有没有看到一只橘猫？它从昨天晚上就没回家了。
en: You haven't seen a ginger cat around here, have you? She hasn't come home since last night.
alt: Have you seen an orange cat around the street by any chance? She's been missing since last night.
point: 礼貌打听用 You haven't…, have you?；橘猫说 ginger cat

zh: 我们想把两家之间那道旧围栏换掉，你们有没有兴趣一起分摊费用？
en: We're thinking of replacing the old fence between our places. Would you be interested in going halves on it?
alt: We'd like to put up a new fence between us. Would you be keen to split the cost?
point: Would you be interested in -ing?；对半分摊说 go halves

zh: 如果我们搬家，宽带能直接转到新地址吗？还是得重新签合同？
en: If we move house, can we take our broadband with us to the new address, or do we have to sign a new contract?
alt: When we move, can the broadband be transferred to the new place, or is it a new contract?
point: 选择疑问 can we…, or do we have to…?；搬家说 move house

zh: 你知道这个月账单为什么比平时多了一百块吗？我们这个月都没怎么在家。
en: Do you have any idea why this month's bill is a hundred dollars more than usual? We've barely been home.
alt: Any idea why the bill's a hundred bucks higher this month? We've hardly been here.
point: Do you have any idea why … is，后面用陈述语序

zh: 你给电力公司打电话的时候，他们有没有说大概什么时候能来电？
en: When you rang the power company, did they give you any idea when the power would be back on?
alt: Did the power company say roughly when it'd be restored when you called them?
point: give you any idea when…；时态随 did 后移用 would

zh: 你们这周能不能派人来看一下？天花板漏水越来越严重了。
en: Is there any chance you could send someone round this week? The leak in the ceiling's getting worse.
alt: Could you get someone out to us this week? The ceiling leak is getting worse.
point: Is there any chance you could…? 委婉催促；派人上门 send someone round

zh: 这个报价包括材料费吗？还是材料要另外算？
en: Does this quote include materials, or are those going to be charged separately?
alt: Is that price with materials, or are they extra?
point: 选择疑问后半句用被动 are those going to be charged

zh: 你上次请的那个建筑工怎么样？干活靠谱吗？价钱公道吗？
en: How did you find that builder you used last time? Was he reliable, and were his prices reasonable?
alt: What was that builder you had in like? Was he any good, and was he fairly priced?
point: How did you find…? 是问评价，不是问“怎么找到的”

zh: 我想确认一下，我的签证申请材料你们收到了没有？我两个星期前寄的。
en: I'm just calling to check whether you've received my visa application. I posted it two weeks ago.
alt: Could you confirm if my visa application has arrived? I sent it a fortnight ago.
point: 打电话确认用 I'm just calling to check whether…

zh: 你知道把中国驾照换成新西兰驾照要带哪些材料吗？我下个月想去办。
en: Do you know what I need to bring to convert my Chinese licence? I'm hoping to sort it out next month.
alt: What documents do I need to swap my overseas licence for a New Zealand one, do you know?
point: 间接疑问 what I need；驾照英式拼 licence

zh: 你们家的建筑许可是自己去申请的，还是让建筑商帮你办的？
en: Did you apply for the building consent yourselves, or did you get the builder to handle it?
alt: Did you sort out the building consent on your own, or did the builder deal with it?
point: 建筑许可是 building consent；让人代办说 get sb to do

zh: 你能告诉我你现在的具体位置吗？附近有没有什么明显的标志？
en: Can you tell me exactly where you are right now? Are there any landmarks you can see nearby?
alt: Where are you exactly at the moment? Can you see anything nearby that stands out?
point: 间接疑问 where you are 不倒装；显眼的标志说 landmarks

zh: 那天晚上你把车停在哪儿了？被偷之前你确定锁了吗？
en: Where had you parked the car that night, and are you sure you'd locked it before it was stolen?
alt: Where was the car parked that night, and did you definitely lock it?
point: 更早的动作用过去完成 had parked / you'd locked

zh: 暴雨那几天你们家进水了没有？保险公司那边怎么说？
en: Did your place get flooded during the storm? What did the insurance company say about it?
alt: Did any water get into your house in the storm? What have the insurers said?
point: 进水说 get flooded；What did … say 别漏 did

zh: 你知道这附近哪儿可以免费停车吗？市中心的停车楼太贵了。
en: Do you know anywhere around here where you can park for free? The parking buildings in town are so expensive.
alt: Is there any free parking around here, do you know? The car park buildings in the city cost a fortune.
point: 间接疑问 where you can park；免费停车说 park for free

zh: 修车师傅有没有说刹车的问题严不严重？现在还能开吗？
en: Did the mechanic say how serious the brake problem is, and whether it's still safe to drive?
alt: What did the mechanic say about the brakes? Is the car OK to drive for now?
point: 两个间接疑问 how serious … is / whether it's safe，都不倒装

zh: 你早上开车上班一般要多久？堵车的时候呢？
en: How long does your drive to work usually take in the morning, and what about when the traffic's bad?
alt: What's your usual morning commute, and how long is it when the traffic's heavy?
point: 追问用 what about…?；堵车说 the traffic's bad

zh: 你们走Tongariro Crossing是几月份？那时候天气怎么样？
en: What month did you do the Tongariro Crossing, and what was the weather like?
alt: When did you walk the Tongariro Crossing, and how was the weather?
point: 问天气说 What was the weather like?，不说 How was the weather like

zh: 我们露营要不要带块防水布？天气预报说周日可能会下雨。
en: Should we bring a tarp for the camping trip? The forecast says it might rain on Sunday.
alt: Is it worth packing a tarp? Apparently there could be rain on Sunday.
point: “要不要带”说 Should we bring…?；防水布叫 tarp

zh: 你知道这个季节海水有多冷吗？我挺想下去游一下的。
en: Have you got any idea how cold the water is this time of year? I'm keen to go for a swim.
alt: How cold is the sea at this time of year, do you know? I'd quite like a swim.
point: 间接疑问 how cold the water is；“挺想”说 keen to

zh: 你知道今年的元宵灯会是哪个周末吗？我想带爸妈去看看。
en: Do you know which weekend the Lantern Festival is on this year? I'd like to take my parents along.
alt: When's the Lantern Festival this year, do you know? I want to bring my parents.
point: 间接疑问 which weekend … is on；活动举行说 be on

zh: 你平时都在哪儿买二手书？我想找几本便宜的英文小说。
en: Where do you usually go for second-hand books? I'm after a few cheap novels in English.
alt: Where's a good place to buy used books? I'm looking for some cheap English novels.
point: “想找某物”说 be after；去哪儿买说 go for

zh: 你有没有兴趣周二晚上跟我们一起参加问答之夜？我们队还差一个人。
en: Would you be up for joining our team at quiz night on Tuesdays? We're one person short.
alt: Are you keen to join our quiz team on Tuesday nights? We need one more.
point: 口语邀请 Would you be up for -ing?；差一个人 one short

zh: 你觉得给Kiwi同事发红包会不会奇怪？还是送个小礼物更好？
en: Do you think it'd be weird to give my Kiwi colleagues red envelopes, or would a small gift be better?
alt: Would red envelopes seem strange to my Kiwi workmates, or should I just get them a small present?
point: Do you think it'd be…；选择疑问后半句 would … be better

zh: 去葬礼一定要穿黑色吗？还是穿得素一点就行？
en: Do we have to wear black to the funeral, or is anything dark and plain fine?
alt: Is black a must for the funeral, or will something dark and simple do?
point: 穿去某场合说 wear … to；选择疑问后半 or is…

zh: 你们打算怎么过结婚十周年？有没有什么特别的安排？
en: How are you celebrating your tenth wedding anniversary? Have you got anything special planned?
alt: What are you doing for your tenth anniversary? Anything special lined up?
point: Have you got anything planned? 过去分词放最后

zh: 如果孩子下周请病假，我需要给学校写请假条吗？还是打个电话就行？
en: If my son's off sick next week, do I need to write a note for the school, or is a phone call enough?
alt: When my son's home sick, should I send the school a note, or will ringing them do?
point: 请病假说 off sick；选择疑问 or is … enough?

zh: 你是怎么管孩子玩手机的时间的？你们家有没有什么规矩？
en: How do you manage your kids' screen time? Do you have any rules about phones?
alt: How do you limit how long your kids spend on their phones? Have you got house rules?
point: 玩手机的时间说 screen time；How do you manage…?

zh: 你妈过来帮你们带孩子的时候，你们会不会因为教育方式起冲突？
en: When your mum comes over to look after the kids, do you ever clash over how to raise them?
alt: Do you and your mum ever disagree about parenting when she's helping with the kids?
point: 意见不合说 clash over；带孩子说 look after

zh: 你们出国那段时间，狗是送去寄养了，还是请人到家里照顾？
en: While you were overseas, did you put the dog in kennels, or did you get someone to look after him at home?
alt: When you went overseas, did the dog go to kennels or did someone house-sit?
point: 寄养说 put in kennels；选择疑问两半都倒装

zh: 你能推荐个靠谱的兽医吗？我家猫最近老是不吃东西。
en: Could you recommend a decent vet? Our cat's been off her food for the last few days.
alt: Do you know a good vet around here? Our cat hasn't been eating properly lately.
point: “不吃东西”说 off her food；靠谱说 decent

zh: 你知道房东让不让养猫吗？租约上写得不太清楚。
en: Do you know if the landlord's OK with cats? The tenancy agreement isn't very clear about it.
alt: Any idea whether cats are allowed? The tenancy agreement doesn't really say.
point: 间接疑问 if the landlord's OK with…，不说 does the landlord allow

zh: 你是不是还在为那件事怪我？如果是的话，我们好好谈谈吧。
en: Are you still holding that against me? If you are, I think we should talk it through.
alt: Do you still blame me for what happened? If so, let's sit down and talk about it.
point: 记恨某人说 hold it against me；谈开说 talk it through

zh: 你怎么会觉得大家都在针对你？是有人跟你说了什么吗？
en: What makes you think everyone's out to get you? Has somebody said something to you?
alt: Why do you feel like everyone's against you? Did someone say something?
point: What makes you think 后接陈述语序

zh: 我知道你最近压力很大，有什么我能帮上忙的吗？
en: I know you've been under a lot of pressure lately. Is there anything I can do to help?
alt: I can tell things have been tough lately. Is there anything I can do?
point: Is there anything I can do…? 疑问里用 anything

zh: 能否说明一下今年绩效评估具体采用哪些标准？我想提前做些准备。
en: Could you clarify what criteria will be used for this year's performance review? I'd like to prepare in advance.
alt: Would you mind explaining how this year's performance reviews will be assessed? I'd like to get ready beforehand.
point: Could you clarify what … will be used 间接疑问；标准说 criteria

zh: 下次开会之前，您能否告诉我预算是否已经批下来了？
en: Before our next meeting, would you be able to let me know whether the budget has been approved?
alt: Could you confirm before we next meet whether the budget has been signed off?
point: 正式问法 would you be able to let me know whether…；批准用被动

zh: 我想问一下，公司是否会考虑让员工每周在家办公两天？团队里很多人都很关心这个。
en: May I ask whether the company would consider allowing staff to work from home two days a week? A lot of the team are keen to know.
alt: I was wondering whether management might consider two work-from-home days a week, as many of us are interested.
point: 正式提问 May I ask whether…；consider 后接 -ing

zh: 能否请您确认一下，我们的数据在迁移过程中是否会出现停机？
en: Could you please confirm whether there will be any downtime while our data is being migrated?
alt: Can you confirm if our systems will be unavailable at any point during the data migration?
point: confirm whether + 陈述语序；停机说 downtime

zh: 我想了解一下，如果我们中途取消订阅，已付的年费能否按比例退还？
en: I'd like to know whether we'd receive a pro-rata refund of the annual fee if we cancelled our subscription part-way through.
alt: If we were to cancel mid-term, would any of the annual fee be refunded on a pro-rata basis?
point: 假设用 if we cancelled … would；按比例说 pro-rata

zh: 请问贵公司的系统是否符合我们的数据安全要求？能否提供相关的认证文件？
en: Can you tell us whether your system meets our data security requirements, and could you provide any relevant certifications?
alt: Does your platform comply with our data security standards, and are you able to supply supporting certification?
point: tell us whether … meets 不倒装；第二问用 and could you 连接

zh: （面试结尾）冒昧问一下，这个职位在未来两三年里会有什么样的发展机会？
en: If you don't mind me asking, what sort of development opportunities would there be in this role over the next couple of years?
alt: Could I ask what the career progression might look like in this role over the next two or three years?
point: If you don't mind me asking 软化提问；面试反问用 would there be

zh: 您能谈谈您认为团队目前面临的最大挑战是什么吗？
en: Could you tell me what you see as the biggest challenge facing the team at the moment?
alt: What would you say is the main challenge the team is dealing with right now?
point: 间接疑问 what you see as…；facing 作后置定语

zh: 非常感谢您的录用通知。请问基本工资方面还有没有商量的余地？
en: Thank you very much for the offer. Could I ask whether there's any room for negotiation on the base salary?
alt: Thanks so much for the offer. I was wondering if there's any flexibility on the base salary?
point: 商量余地说 room for negotiation；ask whether there's…

zh: 请问我是否符合学费分期付款的条件？如果可以，需要提交哪些材料？
en: Could you please advise whether I'm eligible to pay my fees in instalments, and if so, what documents I'd need to submit?
alt: Am I able to pay my tuition in instalments, and if so, what paperwork would be required?
point: advise whether…；if so 承接；英式拼 instalments

zh: 我想了解一下我的论文分数为什么比预期低这么多，能否给我一些更具体的反馈？
en: I'd like to understand why my essay received a lower mark than I expected. Would it be possible to get more detailed feedback?
alt: Could you help me understand why my essay was marked lower than I anticipated, and give me some specific feedback?
point: understand why 后不倒装；索要反馈用 Would it be possible to…

zh: 来信是想询问一下，我在中国修的学分能否转到这里的学位上。
en: I'm writing to ask whether any of the credits I completed in China could be transferred towards my degree here.
alt: I'd like to find out if the credits I earned in China can count towards my qualification here.
point: 写信开头 I'm writing to ask whether…；转学分 transfer credits

zh: 我们订的沙发已经比约定时间晚了三周。能否给我们一个确定的送货日期，并说明延误原因？
en: Our sofa is now three weeks overdue. Could you please give us a firm delivery date and explain what has caused the delay?
alt: The sofa we ordered is three weeks late. When exactly will it be delivered, and why has it been held up?
point: 确定日期说 a firm date；间接疑问 what has caused the delay

zh: 请问你们的花园养护是按小时收费还是按次收费？是否包括清运树枝杂草？
en: Could you let me know whether your garden maintenance is charged by the hour or per visit, and whether green waste removal is included?
alt: Do you charge hourly or per visit for garden maintenance, and is taking away green waste part of the service?
point: 并列两个 whether 从句；按小时说 by the hour

zh: 请问你们的保洁员需要我们提供清洁用品吗？如果我们不在家，他们能自己进门吗？
en: Will your cleaners need us to supply any products, and would they be able to let themselves in if we're not home?
alt: Do we need to provide cleaning products, and can your staff access the house if we're out?
point: 自己开门进去说 let themselves in；if 从句用现在时

zh: 能否请您确认一下，下一次涨租最早什么时候生效，涨多少？
en: Could you please confirm when the next rent increase would take effect and how much it would be?
alt: Would you mind letting us know the earliest date the next rent review would apply, and the new amount?
point: 两个间接疑问并列；生效说 take effect

zh: 请问您是否介意我们在后院装一个晾衣架？费用由我们承担，搬走时会拆除。
en: Would you have any objection to us installing a clothesline in the back yard? We'd cover the cost and remove it when we move out.
alt: Would you be happy for us to put up a clothesline out the back, at our own cost, removed when we leave?
point: 正式征求同意 Would you have any objection to us -ing?

zh: 我们发现押金到现在还没退。请问是否有什么问题？预计什么时候能处理好？
en: We've noticed our bond still hasn't been refunded. Could you let us know if there's an issue, and when we can expect it to be processed?
alt: Our bond hasn't come back yet. Is there a problem, and when should we expect it to be released?
point: when we can expect it to be processed 间接疑问 + 被动

zh: 我们打算加建一个车库，提交申请之前，想先问问你们有没有什么顾虑。
en: We're planning to build a garage, and before we apply, we wanted to ask whether you'd have any concerns about it.
alt: Before we lodge plans for a garage, we'd like to check whether you have any concerns.
point: 过去式 wanted to ask 更客气；ask whether you'd have…

zh: 请问社区花园目前还接收新成员吗？申请流程是怎样的？
en: Could you tell me whether the community garden is taking on new members, and what the process is for applying?
alt: Is the community garden open to new members at the moment, and how would I go about applying?
point: what the process is 不倒装；接收新成员说 take on

zh: 楼上住户的噪音问题已经持续两个月了，请问你们打算采取什么措施？
en: The noise from the flat upstairs has been going on for two months. Could you tell me what steps you intend to take?
alt: The upstairs noise has continued for two months now. What action do you plan to take?
point: what steps you intend to take 间接疑问；采取措施说 take steps

zh: 能否解释一下，为什么我的账户在没有任何通知的情况下被换成了更贵的套餐？
en: Could you explain why my account was switched to a more expensive plan without any prior notice?
alt: Why was my account moved onto a higher-priced plan without me being informed?
point: explain why my account was switched，被动 + 陈述语序

zh: 请问如果我在合约期满前解约，需要支付多少违约金？
en: Could you advise what early termination fee would apply if I ended my broadband contract before the term is up?
alt: How much would I have to pay to break my broadband contract before the end of the term?
point: 违约金说 early termination fee；假设用 would apply

zh: 鉴于这个月我们断网超过五天，请问能否减免一部分费用？
en: Given that we were without internet for over five days this month, would we be entitled to a partial credit on our bill?
alt: Since our connection was down for more than five days this month, could some of the charge be credited back?
point: Given that 正式开头；有权获得说 be entitled to

zh: 能否请您确认一下，热水器的维修费用是否在我们的保险范围之内？
en: Could you confirm whether the cost of repairing our hot water cylinder would be covered under our policy?
alt: Would repairs to our hot water cylinder be covered by our insurance policy?
point: 保险范围说 covered under our policy；confirm whether 不倒装

zh: 工程已经比原定工期晚了一个月，请问能否提供一份更新的时间表，并说明延误原因？
en: The work is now a month behind schedule. Would you be able to provide an updated timeline, along with an explanation for the delay?
alt: As the project is running a month late, could you send through a revised timeline and the reasons for the delay?
point: 工期延误说 behind schedule；Would you be able to provide…?

zh: 请问这份报价的有效期是多久？如果我们下个月才开工，价格会变吗？
en: How long is this quote valid for, and would the price change if we didn't start until next month?
alt: For how long does this quote stand, and would it still apply if work began next month?
point: valid for 介词放句末；“才开工”说 not … until

zh: 我买的洗碗机才用了两个月就坏了，请问我可以要求换新的吗，还是只能维修？
en: My dishwasher broke down after only two months. Am I entitled to a replacement, or are you only able to offer a repair?
alt: The dishwasher stopped working after just two months. Can I get it replaced, or will it only be repaired?
point: 正式选择疑问 Am I entitled to…, or are you only able to…?

zh: 我想知道，为什么我的退款十天前就批准了，到现在还没到账？
en: I'd like to know why my refund, which was approved ten days ago, still hasn't appeared in my account.
alt: Could you tell me why my refund hasn't come through yet, given it was approved ten days ago?
point: I'd like to know why + 陈述语序；中间可插入定语从句

zh: 请问贵店是否提供企业批量采购折扣？我们公司需要采购大约三十台显示器。
en: Do you offer any discounts on bulk orders for businesses? We're looking to purchase around thirty monitors for our office.
alt: Is there a corporate discount for large orders? Our company needs roughly thirty monitors.
point: 批量订单说 bulk orders；正式“打算”说 be looking to

zh: 昨晚我们的主菜等了一个多小时。能否解释一下问题出在哪里，以及你们会如何避免再次发生？
en: We waited over an hour for our mains last night. Could you explain what went wrong, and what you'll do to prevent it happening again?
alt: Our mains took more than an hour last night. What happened, and how will you make sure it doesn't recur?
point: what went wrong 主语疑问不加 did；prevent it happening

zh: 我们想在贵餐厅办公司年终聚餐，请问能否包场？有没有最低消费？
en: We're hoping to hold our end-of-year function at your restaurant. Would exclusive use be possible, and is there a minimum spend?
alt: We'd like to book your restaurant for our work Christmas party. Can we have the whole venue, and is there a minimum spend?
point: 包场说 exclusive use；最低消费 minimum spend

zh: 请问你们的厨房能否保证菜品完全无麸质，不会交叉污染？我女儿有乳糜泻。
en: Can your kitchen guarantee that dishes are completely gluten-free with no cross-contamination? My daughter has coeliac disease.
alt: Are you able to ensure there's no risk of gluten cross-contamination? My daughter is coeliac.
point: guarantee that + 从句；乳糜泻英式拼 coeliac

zh: 能否解释一下，为什么我的信用卡在没有事先通知我的情况下被冻结了？
en: Could you please explain why my credit card was frozen without me being notified first?
alt: Why was my credit card blocked without any prior notification to me?
point: 被动 was frozen；“没通知我”说 without me being notified

zh: 我们想再贷一笔款用于装修，请问按我们目前的收入大概能借多少？
en: We're looking to borrow more for renovations. Could you give us an indication of how much we'd be able to borrow based on our current income?
alt: We'd like to top up our loan for renovations. Roughly how much could we borrow on our current income?
point: give an indication of how much 间接疑问；贷款加借说 top up

zh: 请问如果我们提前还清房贷，会被收取违约费吗？如果会，是怎么计算的？
en: If we were to repay our mortgage early, would we be charged a break fee, and if so, how is it calculated?
alt: Would there be a break fee if we paid off the mortgage ahead of schedule, and how would it be worked out?
point: 正式假设 If we were to…；被动 would we be charged

zh: 来信是想查询我的工作签证申请目前的进度，以及大概还需要等多久。
en: I'm writing to enquire about the status of my work visa application and how much longer I can expect to wait.
alt: Could you please update me on where my work visa application is at, and how long it is likely to take?
point: enquire about（英式拼法）+ how much longer I can expect

zh: 请问我在自家院子里砍掉一棵大树，是否需要先申请许可？
en: Could you please advise whether I'd need a permit to remove a large tree from my own property?
alt: Do I require council approval before cutting down a large tree on my section?
point: advise whether I'd need；正式用 remove 而不是 cut

zh: 我收到的退税金额和我自己算的不一致，能否帮我核实一下计算是否正确？
en: The tax refund I've received doesn't match my own calculations. Could you check whether it has been calculated correctly?
alt: My refund is different from what I worked out. Would you be able to confirm the figure is correct?
point: check whether it has been calculated，被动 + 陈述语序

zh: 能否告诉我，我目前在手术等候名单上排第几？大概什么时候能安排日期？
en: Could you tell me where I currently am on the waiting list for my surgery, and roughly when I might expect a date?
alt: How far up the surgery waiting list am I at the moment, and when am I likely to be given a date?
point: 间接疑问 where I currently am，am 放最后

zh: 我的理赔申请一个多月前就提交了，请问为什么还没处理？是否还需要补充材料？
en: I submitted my claim over a month ago. Could you explain why it hasn't been processed yet, and whether you need any further information?
alt: My claim went in more than a month ago. Why is it still pending, and is anything else required from me?
point: why it hasn't been processed 与 whether 并列

zh: 做这项检查需要GP开转诊单吗？还是我可以自己直接预约？
en: Will I need a referral from my GP for this scan, or am I able to book it directly myself?
alt: Is a GP referral required for this scan, or can patients book in directly?
point: 转诊说 referral；选择疑问正式说 am I able to

zh: 我们家在地震中受损了，请问评估员最早什么时候可以上门查看？
en: Our house was damaged in the earthquake. When is the earliest an assessor could come out to inspect it?
alt: Our home sustained earthquake damage. How soon could someone come and assess it?
point: When is the earliest…? 问最早时间；评估员 assessor

zh: 我上周报了入室盗窃案，想了解一下案件有没有什么进展。
en: I reported a burglary last week and wanted to ask whether there have been any developments in the case.
alt: I'm following up on the burglary I reported last week. Has there been any progress?
point: ask whether there have been any developments；进展 developments
