point: too good to be true 地道；暗藏的坑 What's the catch?

zh: 我不想多嘴，但你们俩有没有想过在背房贷之前先把消费贷还清？
en: I don't want to overstep, but have you two thought about clearing that personal loan before you take on a mortgage?
alt: It's not really my place, but have you considered paying off the personal loan before buying?
point: 委婉开口 I don't want to overstep；背上贷款 take on

zh: 我就不点名了，上次聚餐的钱是不是还有人没转给我？
en: Not to name names, but has everyone actually paid me back for the dinner the other night?
alt: I won't point any fingers, but are we all square for dinner the other night?
point: Not to name names 半开玩笑；还钱说 pay back

zh: 他们真的需要这么多证明吗？还是就喜欢让人来回跑？
en: Do they really need all these documents, or do they just enjoy sending people round in circles?
alt: Is all this paperwork actually necessary, or is it just to keep us running around?
point: 反问式抱怨；白跑 go round in circles

zh: 我已经在这儿等了快两个小时了，请问有没有任何办法能快一点？
en: I've been waiting nearly two hours now. Is there anything at all that could be done to speed things up?
alt: It's been almost two hours. Is there any way at all of moving things along?
point: 礼貌施压 Is there anything at all that could be done…?

zh: 你签字之前真的把那张表看仔细了吗？他们可不是那种会给你第二次机会的人。
en: Are you sure you read that form properly before you signed it? They're not exactly known for giving second chances, are they?
alt: Did you go through that form carefully before signing? They don't tend to let mistakes slide.
point: 反语 not exactly known for；反义疑问拉对方认同

zh: 我知道这话不太好说，但你最近是不是喝得比平时多了点？我挺担心你的。
en: I know it's a bit awkward to bring up, but have you been drinking a bit more than usual lately? I'm worried about you.
alt: This isn't easy to say, but have you noticed you're drinking more these days? I'm a bit concerned.
point: 敏感话题先铺垫 it's awkward to bring up；a bit more than usual 软化

zh: 你不是说只是小感冒吗？都两个星期了还没好，是不是该去看看GP了？
en: Didn't you say it was just a cold? It's been two weeks now, so isn't it about time you saw a GP?
alt: I thought it was only a cold? Two weeks on, shouldn't you be getting it checked by a GP?
point: 委婉催促 isn't it about time you + 过去式

zh: 医生，您说“不用太担心”，具体是什么意思？我需要做些什么吗？
en: When you say there's no need to worry too much, what exactly does that mean in practice? Is there anything I should be doing?
alt: What do you mean by 'not too worried', practically speaking? Should I be doing anything differently?
point: 追问话里含义 what exactly does that mean in practice?

zh: 你家应急用的水和食物真的备够了吗？说真的，别等大地震来了才手忙脚乱。
en: Have you actually got enough water and food stashed away for an emergency? Seriously, you don't want to be caught out when the big one hits.
alt: Is your emergency supply of food and water properly stocked? You really don't want to get caught short.
point: 措手不及 be caught out；大地震常说 the big one

zh: 你确定刚才那声音不是有人想撬门进来？要不要我陪你出去看看？
en: Are you sure that noise wasn't someone trying to get in? Do you want me to come out with you and have a look?
alt: That didn't sound like someone trying the door to you? Shall I come and check with you?
point: 否定推测 wasn't someone -ing；Do you want me to…? 主动陪同

zh: 车被撞了你还那么冷静，你是怎么做到的？换我早就慌得不行了。
en: How on earth did you keep so calm after the crash? I'd have been a complete mess if it had been me.
alt: How did you stay so cool after someone ran into you? I would've totally lost it.
point: 惊讶用 How on earth；虚拟 I'd have been … if it had been me

zh: 翻山那段弯弯曲曲的路，你开的时候会不会心里发毛？还是早就习惯了？
en: Does that windy road over the hill ever freak you out, or are you used to it by now?
alt: Do you ever get nervous on that winding hill road, or is it second nature these days?
point: 心里发毛 freak you out；or are you used to it by now?

zh: 我不是说你开车技术不好，但你不觉得该慢一点了吗？这已经是这个月第二张超速罚单了。
en: I'm not saying you're a bad driver, but don't you think it's time to ease off a bit? That's your second speeding ticket this month.
alt: Not having a go at your driving, but shouldn't you slow down a touch? That's two speeding tickets this month.
point: I'm not saying…, but 软化批评；放慢 ease off

zh: 你确定导航没出错？我们好像已经在这个环岛绕了三圈了。
en: Are we sure the GPS knows what it's doing? I'm fairly certain we've been round this roundabout three times now.
alt: Is the sat nav having a laugh? I swear this is our third lap of this roundabout.
point: 幽默质疑 Are we sure it knows what it's doing?

zh: 这次你记得买旅行保险了吗？我可不想再重演上次那一出。
en: Did you remember to get travel insurance this time? I really don't want a repeat of what happened last time.
alt: You did sort out travel insurance this time, didn't you? Let's not have a repeat of last trip.
point: Did you remember to…? 暗含提醒；重演 a repeat of

zh: 一个星期跑五个城市？你确定这叫度假，而不是体能测试？
en: Five cities in one week? Are you sure that's a holiday and not some kind of endurance test?
alt: Five cities in seven days? That sounds less like a holiday and more like a marathon, doesn't it?
point: 幽默反问 Are you sure that's … and not…?

zh: 希望这个请求不算太过分，请问能不能晚点退房？还是要另外收费？
en: I hope this isn't too cheeky, but is there any chance of a late checkout, or would that cost us extra?
alt: This might be a bit cheeky, but could we possibly check out a little later, or is there a charge for that?
point: 委婉请求 I hope this isn't too cheeky；any chance of + 名词

zh: 预报说下午有大风，我们真的还要上山吗？要不改天吧？
en: The forecast's saying gale-force winds this afternoon. Are we really still going up the mountain, or should we call it off and try another day?
alt: With gales forecast for this afternoon, do we really want to go up? Shouldn't we postpone?
point: Are we really still…? 表疑虑；取消 call it off

zh: 你走那条步道之前，有没有把行程告诉别人？万一出了事怎么办？
en: Did you leave your intentions with anyone before you headed off on that track? What if something had gone wrong?
alt: Did anyone know where you were going on that tramp? What would've happened if you'd got into trouble?
point: NZ 徒步说 leave your intentions；虚拟 What if … had gone wrong?

zh: 你不是真打算穿人字拖去爬那座山吧？这也太随意了吧？
en: You're not seriously going to tackle that climb in jandals, are you? Isn't that taking the laid-back Kiwi thing a bit far?
alt: Jandals, for that climb? Really? That's a bit too relaxed even for a Kiwi, isn't it?
point: 做过头 take something a bit far；人字拖 NZ 叫 jandals

zh: 你们队上周被打得那么惨，教练是不是也该重新考虑一下战术了？
en: After the hiding you lot copped last week, isn't it about time the coach rethought the game plan?
alt: After getting thrashed like that last week, shouldn't the coach be rethinking his tactics?
point: Kiwi 说惨败 cop a hiding；isn't it about time…

zh: 你周末不是说要去健身房吗？怎么最后变成在沙发上看橄榄球了？
en: Weren't you meant to be hitting the gym this weekend? How did that turn into watching the rugby on the couch?
alt: I thought the plan was the gym this weekend? How did you end up on the couch watching rugby?
point: 去健身 hit the gym；How did that turn into…? 调侃

zh: 你确定要赌他们输？人家这个赛季一场都没输过，你不会没注意到吧。
en: Are you sure you want to bet against them? They haven't lost a single game all season, in case you hadn't noticed.
alt: You're betting against them? You do know they're unbeaten this season, right?
point: 带点揶揄 in case you hadn't noticed

zh: 我知道你是铁粉，但一张票两百块，真的值吗？在网上看看不就行了？
en: I know you're a massive fan, but is it really worth two hundred bucks a ticket? Couldn't you just watch it online?
alt: I get that you love them, but two hundred dollars a ticket? Wouldn't streaming it do?
point: Couldn't you just…? 委婉反对

zh: 你是怎么做到一个月看完五本书的？你到底睡不睡觉啊？
en: How do you manage to get through five books a month? Do you ever actually sleep, or what?
alt: Five books a month? When do you find the time? Do you even sleep?
point: 读完 get through；…, or what? 口语幽默追问

zh: 你到底是真喜欢钓鱼，还是只是想找个借口在外面待一整天？
en: Do you genuinely enjoy fishing, or is it more of an excuse to spend the whole day out of the house?
alt: Is it the fishing you love, or just having a reason to escape for the day?
point: 调侃式选择疑问 or is it more of an excuse…?

zh: 我们都说要聚说了快一年了，是不是该把日子定下来了？不然又拖到明年了。
en: We've been saying we'll catch up for about a year now. Shall we actually lock in a date before it slides into next year?
alt: We keep saying we'll get together. How about we pin down a date before another year goes by?
point: 定下日期 lock in a date；拖到 slide into

zh: 你那天说“随便”，是真的随便，还是其实心里早就有想去的地方了？
en: When you said 'whatever's fine', did you really mean it, or have you secretly got somewhere in mind?
alt: When you said you didn't mind, was that true, or is there actually a place you're hoping for?
point: 识破客套 did you really mean it?；心里有数 have somewhere in mind

zh: 拜托告诉我你没真的把那条消息发到群里。大家都已经看到了吗？
en: Please tell me you didn't actually post that in the group chat. Has everyone already seen it?
alt: You didn't really send that to the group, did you? Has everyone read it?
point: Please tell me you didn't… 表示惊恐；接着追问 Has everyone…?

zh: 是我的错觉吗，他在婚礼上的致辞是不是有点太长了？我中间差点睡着。
en: Was it just me, or did his speech at the wedding go on a bit? I nearly nodded off halfway through.
alt: Am I being harsh, or was his wedding speech a tad long? I almost dozed off.
point: Was it just me, or…? 委婉吐槽；啰嗦 go on a bit；打瞌睡 nod off

zh: 你觉得送礼品卡会不会显得有点没诚意？还是说这样其实最实用？
en: Would a gift card come across as a bit lazy, or is that actually the most practical thing to give these days?
alt: Does a voucher look like we couldn't be bothered, or is it the most sensible option?
point: 显得 come across as；选择疑问表纠结

zh: 今年圣诞到底去你家还是我家过？我们总不能每年十二月都吵一次吧？
en: So whose family are we doing Christmas with this year? We can't have the same argument every December, can we?
alt: Which side of the family gets us this Christmas? Surely we're not going to have this fight every year?
point: 反义疑问 can we? 寻求认同；do Christmas with

zh: 你是不是对他太严了点？他才八岁，偶尔玩会儿游戏有那么严重吗？
en: Do you think you might be coming down a bit hard on him? He's only eight, so is the odd game really such a big deal?
alt: Aren't you being a little tough on him? He's eight, so is a game now and then really a problem?
point: 层层软化 Do you think you might be…；偶尔的 the odd

zh: 你妈要来住三个月，你本来打算什么时候跟我商量？
en: When exactly were you going to run it past me that your mum's coming to stay for three months?
alt: Were you planning to mention at some point that your mum's moving in for three months?
point: 带不满的追问 When were you going to…？；先征求意见 run it past me

zh: 孩子们真的睡了吗？还是又躲在被子里偷偷玩平板？
en: Are the kids actually asleep yet, or are they hiding under the duvet playing on the iPad again?
alt: Are the kids really asleep, or have they smuggled the iPad into bed again?
point: 调侃式选择疑问；被子英式说 duvet

zh: 你确定我们准备好再养一条狗了吗？你看看现在这条把沙发啃成什么样了。
en: Are you sure we're ready for a second dog? Have you seen what the first one's done to the couch?
alt: Another dog, really? Have you had a look at the state of the couch lately?
point: 反问提醒 Have you seen what…?；不说 Look the sofa

zh: 你家猫是不是又在门口给你留“礼物”了？你觉得它是不是以为在帮你忙？
en: Has your cat left you another 'present' on the doorstep? Do you reckon it thinks it's doing you a favour?
alt: Another dead mouse on the doormat? Does your cat honestly think it's helping?
point: 插入 do you reckon 后陈述语序；帮忙 do you a favour

zh: 我知道你很疼它，但每天喂这么多零食真的是为它好吗？兽医都说它超重了。
en: I know you adore him, but is giving him that many treats really doing him any favours? The vet did say he's overweight.
alt: I know he's your baby, but are all those treats actually good for him? The vet said he's carrying extra weight.
point: 反问暗示有害 doing him any favours?；did say 加强语气

zh: 我是不是说错什么了？从吃饭开始你就一直不怎么说话，我也想不出是哪儿得罪你了。
en: Did I say something to upset you? You've been really quiet since dinner and I can't work out what I did.
alt: Have I put my foot in it somehow? You've barely said a word since dinner.
point: 主动询问 Did I say something to upset you?；想不出 can't work out

zh: 你是真的没事，还是只是不想让我担心才这么说？
en: Are you genuinely OK, or are you just saying that so I won't worry about you?
alt: Are you really fine, or is that just for my benefit?
point: 识破客套 or are you just saying that…?

zh: 你不觉得你对自己太苛刻了吗？要是别人犯了这个错，你早就原谅他了，不是吗？
en: Aren't you being a bit hard on yourself? If anyone else had made that mistake, you'd have let it go in a heartbeat, wouldn't you?
alt: Aren't you being too tough on yourself? You'd forgive anyone else for that in a second.
point: 对自己苛刻 be hard on yourself；虚拟 + 反义疑问 wouldn't you?
